row: Dr. Katie Woodley - The Natural Pet Doctor

Are you exhausted from watching your pet struggle with chronic diarrhea, vomiting, reflux, or itchy skin — and feel like you’ve tried everything with no real answers?

You’re not failing your pet.
Most chronic gut and skin issues persist because the root cause is being missed.

I’m Dr. Katie Woodley, holistic veterinarian and founder of The Natural Pet Doctor. On this channel, I help pet parents understand why these issues happen and what supports real healing.

Here you’ll learn:
✔️ Why symptom-based treatments stop working
✔️ How gut, immune, and inflammatory health connect
✔️ When food changes help — and when they backfire
✔️ How functional testing reveals what bloodwork misses

My work is rooted in whole-food nutrition, herbal medicine, and functional testing — not quick fixes.

Download my free Gut Health Guide
👉 https://www.thenaturalpetdoctor.com/gut-health-starter-guide

If you’re ready to stop chasing symptoms and start supporting true healing, you’re in the right place.
